title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 9 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 9 De sacrae Scripturae partibus COMPLETE (PHYS 290–mid-302 before Cap. 10).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 9 On Sacred Scripture's parts, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (PHYS 290–mid-302): partes defined as canonical OT/NT books; duplex criterion (internal inspiration and external catholic testimony); four inferences on canonical authority, one canon reason, judging controversies, and scriptural sufficiency against unwritten word; OT historical/poetic/prophetic classes; Apocrypha; NT four integral parts (evangelical, practical, epistolary, apocalyptic). Cap. 10 begins PHYS 302; Cap. 8 complete; the rest of the Syntagma remains.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for Liber I Cap. 9 densify complete.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 9 densify COMPLETE, reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS 290–mid-302 before CAPUT DECIMUM). Same-page OCR (tesseract lat + Vision) used as check. No modern English was copied. Cap. 10 (CAPUT DECIMUM / De principio S.S. Theologiae a primo dependente) begins PHYS 302. Cap. 11 CAPUT UNDECIMUM PHYS 323. No Internet Archive copy was located.
